vocabulary.meaning_en: an interesting place that brings visitors
vocabulary.example: The tower is the city's most famous attraction.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a building where old, interesting or scientific objects are kept and shown
vocabulary.example: We spent three hours in the history museum.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a place where paintings and sculptures are shown or sold
vocabulary.example: Her paintings are on show at a small art gallery.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a building or statue made to remember a person or event
vocabulary.example: There is a monument to the war heroes in the square.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a large strong old building with thick walls, built for protection
vocabulary.example: The castle stands on top of the hill.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a large, grand house of a king or queen
vocabulary.example: The king lived in a beautiful palace.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a public green area in a town
vocabulary.example: Let's have a picnic in the park.

vocabulary.meaning_en: an open area in a city surrounded by buildings
vocabulary.example: The café is in the main square.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a place where wild animals are kept for people to see
vocabulary.example: The children loved the elephants at the zoo.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a building with large tanks where you see sea creatures
vocabulary.note_ar: الحوض الصغير في البيت يسمى fish tank
vocabulary.example: We saw sharks at the aquarium.
vocabulary.note_en: A small one at home is called a 'fish tank'.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a large park with exciting rides and shows
vocabulary.example: Disneyland is a famous theme park.

vocabulary.meaning_en: visiting famous places as a tourist
vocabulary.example: We went sightseeing on our first day.
vocabulary.note_en: 'Go sightseeing' = walk around to see the famous places.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a visit with a guide who explains the place
vocabulary.example: We joined a guided tour of the palace.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a person who shows tourists around and explains things
vocabulary.example: Our tour guide spoke four languages.

vocabulary.meaning_en: money you pay to go into a place
vocabulary.example: The entry fee for children is half price.

vocabulary.meaning_en: something you buy to remember a place or holiday
vocabulary.example: I bought a small souvenir for my sister.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a small ring or chain for holding keys
vocabulary.example: He bought a key chain as a souvenir.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the art or activity of taking photos
vocabulary.example: Photography is not allowed in this room.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a short trip for fun, often for one day
vocabulary.example: We went on an excursion to the mountains.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a public show of art or objects for a limited time
vocabulary.example: The science exhibition ends next month.

vocabulary.meaning_en: connected with history
vocabulary.example: This is a historical castle.

vocabulary.meaning_en: connected with the art, ideas and customs of a society
vocabulary.example: The city has many cultural events.

vocabulary.meaning_en: made by nature, not by people
vocabulary.example: The waterfall is a natural wonder.

vocabulary.meaning_en: known by many people
vocabulary.example: Paris is famous for the Eiffel Tower.

vocabulary.meaning_en: liked by many people
vocabulary.example: This beach is popular with families.

vocabulary.meaning_en: full of people
vocabulary.example: The museum is crowded on Sundays.
vocabulary.note_en: From 'crowd' = a large group of people.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a website where someone writes regularly about their life or interests
vocabulary.example: She writes a travel blog.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a small card with information about an object
vocabulary.example: Read the label to learn how old the vase is.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to stand in a special position for a photo
vocabulary.example: She posed in front of the monument.

vocabulary.meaning_en: never stopping; very many
vocabulary.example: He took endless photos of the sea.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to say firmly that you must do or have something
vocabulary.note_ar: insist on + اسم أو فعل ing
vocabulary.example: Ali insisted on trying every ride.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a machine at a theme park that people sit on for fun
vocabulary.example: This ride is too scary for me.
vocabulary.note_en: As a verb it means to travel on something (a bike, a ride at a theme park).

vocabulary.meaning_en: a fast ride that goes up and down on a track
vocabulary.example: She screamed on the roller coaster.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to shout very loudly because of fear or excitement
vocabulary.example: The children screamed with joy.

vocabulary.meaning_en: so good or special that you will always remember it
vocabulary.example: It was an unforgettable day with friends.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a photo you take of yourself
vocabulary.example: He took a selfie with the lion behind him.

vocabulary.meaning_en: an intelligent sea animal
vocabulary.example: The dolphins jumped out of the water.

fine_lines.title: museum vs art gallery vs exhibition
fine_lines.explanation_ar: museum مبنى دائم لحفظ وعرض الآثار والمقتنيات التاريخية أو العلمية، ولا يبيع شيئاً. art gallery مبنى أو قاعة مخصصة لعرض اللوحات والتماثيل الفنية، وغالباً تُباع للجمهور. exhibition عرض مؤقت للجمهور يستمر أسابيع أو شهوراً لعرض فنون أو قطع تاريخية أو منتجات معينة ثم ينتهي.

examples.sentence: The museum has a collection of ancient coins.
You can buy this painting at the art gallery.
The car exhibition runs until the end of May.

fine_lines.explanation_en: A 'museum' is a permanent building that keeps and shows historical or scientific objects; it doesn't sell them. An 'art gallery' is a building or room for showing paintings and sculptures, and they are often for sale. An 'exhibition' is a temporary public show that lasts weeks or months, showing art, historical objects or products, and then it ends.

fine_lines.title: aquarium vs fish tank
fine_lines.explanation_ar: aquarium هنا مبنى كبير فيه أحواض ضخمة لعرض الأسماك والكائنات البحرية للزوار. fish tank هو الحوض الصغير الذي نضعه في البيت أو المحل.

examples.sentence: We watched the sharks at the city aquarium.
My son cleans his fish tank every week.

fine_lines.explanation_en: Here 'aquarium' is a big building with huge tanks where visitors can see fish and sea animals. A 'fish tank' is the small tank we keep at home or in a shop.

fine_lines.title: famous vs popular
fine_lines.explanation_ar: famous تعني أن كثيراً من الناس يعرفونه. popular تعني أن كثيراً من الناس يحبونه أو يفعلونه. قد يكون المكان مشهوراً لكن لا يزوره كثيرون، وقد يكون مكان صغير غير مشهور لكنه محبوب عند أهل المنطقة.

examples.sentence: The castle is famous all over the world.
This little café is popular with students.

fine_lines.explanation_en: 'Famous' means many people know it. 'Popular' means many people like it or do it. A place can be famous but not visited much, and a small place that isn't famous can be popular with local people.

fine_lines.title: by vs for (with time)
fine_lines.explanation_ar: by يأتي بعدها وقت محدد في المستقبل (by 5 p.m.، by next year) بمعنى «بحلول». أما for فيأتي بعدها مدة (for two hours، for five years).

examples.sentence: By 5 p.m., the tour will have ended.
We walked around the city for three hours.

fine_lines.explanation_en: 'By' is followed by a point in future time (by 5 p.m., by next year) and means 'not later than'. 'For' is followed by a length of time (for two hours, for five years).

expressions.example: We finished our exams, so tonight we're going to paint the town red.

expressions.example: We went sightseeing in the old town.
expressions.meaning_en: to go around looking at famous places

expressions.example: This castle was once home to kings.
expressions.meaning_en: a place where someone lived in the past

expressions.example: My little brother insisted on every ride at the theme park.
expressions.meaning_en: to want to go on every ride and not take no for an answer

expressions.example: Our boat trip was an unforgettable excursion.
expressions.meaning_en: a trip you will always remember

expressions.example: We started with the museum and finished at the park.
expressions.meaning_en: to begin with something / to begin at a place

grammar.title: Future perfect continuous: will have been + verb-ing
grammar.explanation_ar: تخيّل ساعة إيقاف (stopwatch) تعمل، ثم انتقلت إلى نقطة في المستقبل لتنظر كم مضى على حدث مستمر حتى تلك النقطة. نستخدم هذا الزمن لقياس مدة حدث مستمر حتى وقت في المستقبل. التركيب: الفاعل + will have been + الفعل مع ing.
examples: By next year, I will have been studying English for three years.
By 5 p.m., Ali will have been waiting for two hours.
By next month, Omar will have been living in London for five years.
grammar.explanation_en: Imagine a stopwatch running, then jump to a point in the future and see how long an ongoing action has lasted up to that point. We use this tense to measure how long something will have been happening by a future time. Form: subject + will have been + verb-ing.

questions.question: A temporary show of art that runs for a few weeks is an:
questions.explanation_en: An exhibition is a temporary show for a set period.

questions.question: Where can you usually buy paintings?
questions.explanation_ar: art gallery تعرض اللوحات وغالباً تبيعها، أما المتحف فلا يبيع.
questions.explanation_en: An art gallery shows paintings and often sells them; a museum does not sell.

questions.question: By next year, I ___ English for three years.
questions.explanation_ar: مدة حدث مستمر حتى نقطة في المستقبل = will have been + ing.
questions.explanation_en: How long an ongoing action lasts up to a future point = will have been + -ing.

questions.question: By 5 p.m., Ali will have been waiting ___ two hours.
questions.explanation_ar: for تأتي مع المدة، و by مع وقت محدد.
questions.explanation_en: 'For' goes with a length of time; 'by' goes with a point in time.

questions.question: "To paint the town red" means to:
questions.explanation_ar: paint the town red = يسهر ويحتفل بصخب.
questions.explanation_en: 'Paint the town red' = go out and celebrate loudly.

questions.question: Something you buy to remember your holiday is a:
questions.explanation_en: Souvenir = something you keep to remember a place.

questions.question: "This castle was once home to kings." Here "once" means:
choices: at some time in the past
questions.explanation_ar: once هنا بمعنى ذات يوم في الماضي.
questions.explanation_en: Here 'once' means 'at some time in the past'.
